title: Modules add features
summary: Apache modules add features such as headers, rewriting or TLS. A directive may require its matching module to be loaded.
introduction: Apache modules add features such as headers, rewriting or TLS. A directive may require its matching module to be loaded. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Apache modules add features such as headers, rewriting or TLS. A directive may require its matching module to be loaded.
This header directive needs mod_headers. It asks browsers not to guess a different type from the supplied content type.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find the module name in the official header documentation.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume every Apache installation loads the same modules.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).
